objective: John Thompson was assigned to perform a boiler house audit, carry out the necessary inspections, and provide recommendations to address any identified deficiencies.
exec_intro: John Thompson was requested to perform a boiler house audit at {customer} on {date}. The audit consisted of a visual inspection of the boiler plant, testing of safety devices, testing of boiler controls and a general inspection of the boiler house and steam reticulation system.

exec_none: No significant deficiencies were noted at the time of the audit.
scope_default: A boiler house audit was performed as detailed in the sections below.
no_issues: No issues noted at time of inspection.
work_done_none: No additional work was performed during the audit.
